Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:148924

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Girish Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- Akash Chandra Maurya,G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No.62 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Narwal, District Kanpur Nagar during pendency of the trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased.

entities.text: Smt Kiran @ Shakuntala Kushwaha vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Cause of death as per postmortem report is Asphyxia ante-mortem hanging.
Information regarding unnatural death of the deceased was given by the applicant's son (husband of the deceased).
Applicant has been implicated in the present case being mother-in-law of the deceased.
Applicant has no criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 08.06.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.
Learned counsel for the informant submitted that prima-facie offence is made out against the applicant.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Smt.Kiran @ Shakuntala Kushwaha, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 12.9.2024 SKD  Smt Kiran @ Shakuntala Kushwaha vs State Of U.P. on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164757004/
